title: Senior Performance Engineer
description:
**Who are we?**
 Checkmarx is the AI\-powered application security leader helping the world’s most security\- conscious enterprises secure the software that powers modern life. For more than two decades, our unified platform and services have helped organizations protect human\- and AI\- generated code from the first line through runtime, reducing risk across applications, cloud, and the software supply chain without slowing innovation.
   

  

 We’re trusted by 1,600\+ customers in 70\+ countries, including some of the largest enterprises and governments in the world. Guided by research\-led innovation and a developer\-first mindset, we help every developer, security team, and enterprise build software that is risk\-free by design.
   

  

**What are we looking for?**
 We are looking for a hands\-on
 **Senior** 
**Performance Engineer** 
 to join our Automation Platform Engineering team.

You will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining performance testing frameworks, creating realistic load, stress, and endurance scenarios, analyzing system behavior, and identifying performance bottlenecks in microservices\-based, Kubernetes, and cloud\-native environments.

 In this role, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Designing and automating complex performance, load, stress, and endurance test scenarios using Python and pytest
* Developing load generators, stress tools, and performance analysis utilities
* Building and maintaining performance dashboards, monitoring, and alerting solutions
* Analyzing application and infrastructure performance to identify bottlenecks and optimization opportunities
* Investigating and troubleshooting performance issues across distributed systems
* Researching, evaluating, and implementing new performance testing techniques and tools
* Collaborating closely with Development, DevOps, and Architecture teams to improve product performance, scalability, and reliability


 Requirements:
   

  

**What is needed to succeed?**
**Required Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of experience in performance, load, and stress testing within Kubernetes and cloud\-native environments
* 5\+ years of hands\-on Python development experience
* Strong Linux troubleshooting and debugging skills
* Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes, including debugging pods, nodes, deployments, jobs, and cluster resources
* Practical experience with AWS, including EC2, VPC/networking concepts, and EKS
* Experience automating performance testing using Python and test frameworks such as pytest
* Experience leveraging AI tools and LLM\-based applications as part of day\-to\-day QA and engineering workflows
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a debugging\-oriented mindset
* Ability to work independently, take ownership, and drive issues through to resolution
* Strong communication and collaboration skills


**Desired Qualifications**
* Familiarity with MongoDB
* Experience with Playwright
* Familiarity with Metabase
* Familiarity with Kubernetes internals (resource management, networking, scheduling, events, etc.)
* Experience with observability tools such as Groundcover, Lens, Prometheus, Grafana, or similar platforms
* Experience with Argo CD
* Understanding of software testing principles and the software development lifecycle (SDLC)


 What we have to offer:
   

  

 Checkmarx offers a collaborative and innovative work environment, professional development opportunities, challenging career paths, competitive compensation, excellent work\-life balance, and outstanding benefits and perks throughout the year.

* Contract extension possible based on performance, with additional benefits including a performance bonus and medical insurance\*


**The Opportunity:**
 Are you passionate about engineering automation solutions that improve efficiency, accuracy, and control at scale? Do you thrive in a fast\-paced, data\-driven environment? Agoda’s Finance Operations Excellence is seeking a VBA Automation Specialist to serve as a hands\-on technical expert focused on designing, developing, and maintaining automation solutions for finance operations. **Automation Architecture \& Development:**
* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain automation solutions using Advanced Excel, Macro/VBA, MS Access, SQL, Power Automate, FloQast, and Power Apps.

**Finance Operations Solution Engineering:**
* Partner with Finance operations teams to understand process requirements, identify technical solution options

**Data Processing \& Logic Design:**
* Develop data models, query logic, input/output structures, and exception\-handling routines using Excel, Access, and SQL.

**Workflow Automation \& Systems Enablement:**
* Build and enhance workflow\-based solutions using Power Automate, FloQast, and Power Apps to reduce manual handoffs, improve process standardization,
* Support stronger controls and transparency across finance operations.


**Technical Documentation \& Change Control:**
 Create and maintain high\-quality technical documentation including solution design notes, process logic, code commenting, SOPs, testing evidence, version histories, and user guidance to ensure sustainable ownership and supportability.

* Troubleshoot defects, resolve production issues, support enhancement requests
* Proactively identify opportunities to refactor or upgrade existing automations.
* Contribute to improving development standards, documentation quality, and reusability of automation components.

* Strong experience with MS Access and SQL for data storage, query development, data transformation, and reporting support.
* Hands\-on experience in workflow automation tools such as Power Automate, FloQast, and Power Apps.
* Strong technical ability to convert business requirements into structured, reliable, and supportable automation solutions.
* Good understanding of process controls, exception handling, validation design, and documentation practices in an operations environment.
* Experience developing automation solutions in Finance operations environments is preferred.
* Python\-based automation, Tableau/Power BI, and ERP scripting experience are not a must but good to have.


**Behavioral Attributes**
* Strong structured problem\-solving skills with the ability to diagnose issues logically and design practical technical solutions.
* Well organized with strong attention to detail, especially in code structure, testing, versioning, and documentation.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to work directly with Finance operations end\-users to gather requirements, explain solutions, and support adoption.
* Strong documentation discipline and a high standard for supportability, clarity, and technical quality.
* Self\-starter with a hands\-on engineering mindset and the ability to independently manage technical deliverables in a fast\-paced environment.
* Adaptable, dependable, and comfortable balancing delivery speed with control and quality.

* Bachelor’s degree in a technical field such as Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.
* 5\+ years of relevant experience in automation development is required (VBA/Excel\-based engineering, Power Automate, Power Apps), Good to have (SQL \& Tableau)

* Experience in a tech or e\-commerce environment is an advantage.
